name: vnbrokers-openapi
description: OpenAPI specifications and bundled build artifacts for vnbrokers.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:fhsc && npm run lint:dnse && npm run lint:tcbs && npm run lint:entrade
scripts.bundle:dnse: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@1.34.3 bundle openapi/vi/DNSE/v2/openapi.yaml -o dist/dnse-v2.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@1.34.3 bundle openapi/vi/DNSE/v2/openapi.yaml -o dist/dnse-v2.json
scripts.bundle:fhsc: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@1.34.3 bundle openapi/vi/FHSC/v0/openapi.yaml -o dist/fhsc-v0.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@1.34.3 bundle openapi/vi/FHSC/v0/openapi.yaml -o dist/fhsc-v0.json
scripts.bundle:tcbs: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@1.34.3 bundle openapi/vi/TCBS/v1/openapi.yaml -o dist/tcbs-v1.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@1.34.3 bundle openapi/vi/TCBS/v1/openapi.yaml -o dist/tcbs-v1.json
scripts.bundle:entrade: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@1.34.3 bundle openapi/vi/Entrade/v1/openapi.yaml -o dist/entrade-v1.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@1.34.3 bundle openapi/vi/Entrade/v1/openapi.yaml -o dist/entrade-v1.json
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:fhsc && npm run bundle:dnse && npm run bundle:tcbs && npm run bundle:entrade
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run bundle
